title: Malacañang condoles with families of Air Force pilots killed in crash

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Monday extended its condolences to the families of four Philippine Air Force pilots who died in a midair collision during a training flight in Batangas, assuring them of the government’s support as they mourned their loss. The pilots died on Oct. 23 in a midair collision involving two aircraft during a training flight near Fernando Air Base in Lipa City, Batangas.
